list: The official 55 trophies, frozen 2026-11-18, verified live 2026-11-19 against Exophase and PSNProfiles, which agree on every name, description and grade. 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze.

sources.label: Exophase — official trophy list (names, descriptions, grades)
PSNProfiles — grades and PSN progress counts
Our own advice, read from the official descriptions — the game released 19 Nov 2026, so no in-game location is pinned down yet

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum unlocks itself. It is the last trophy you will earn, so use this tracker to see what is still open and work the list down to zero.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission, so this trophy comes naturally in the first hour of play — nothing to prepare for.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Keep playing the story; chapters unlock in order, and a chapter trophy can never be missed — missions can be replayed.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Same as every chapter trophy: play the story through and it unlocks when the chapter ends.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Play the story through; the trophy pops when the chapter's last mission ends.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The last chapter before the finale — complete it and the final mission opens up.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. It unlocks after Chapter 4 — the story's last job, worth gold. Do the missable partner trophies before you start it.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run. It comes up during the story — play the missions in order and it unlocks.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. A heist mission in the story's flow — no preparation needed beyond playing it.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. It unlocks as the story reaches it.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. Play the story in order; the mission appears when its chapter reaches it.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown, set at the airport. It is a story mission, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Another story mission — keep playing and it unlocks in turn.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — every story mission, stranger strand, activity and collectible the game counts. Save this for last: when it pops, only the platinum is left. Use the tracker to find what is still open.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts — jumps, drifts, near-misses and airtime while driving. Drive hard everywhere you go and the counter climbs across the whole game; there is no single spot to grind, so just keep stunt driving.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade, PSN count 250). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — races, the shooting range, fishing, the arcade, bowling, meditation and the rest. Sample everything early so you know what each activity is and where it lives.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade, PSN count 9). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Learn each range's target pattern, then retry a challenge as often as you like until the gold score clicks — nothing here is missable, so take your time.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade, PSN count 42). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Work through the locations one by one; a win at each is what counts, so learn each course's line before you race it.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade, PSN count 14). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Enter a new race each time rather than repeating one — only different races count toward the 20, so spread your wins across the race list.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade, PSN count 20). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fish with Cal when the challenge opens and out-fish him — the bigger catch wins.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game. Pick any arcade machine and play a game to its end — the easiest activity trophy in the list.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's final mission. Play Andy's strand through to its last mission — strands unlock as the story opens them up.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's final mission. Same pattern as the other contacts: follow Kenton's strand to its end.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's final mission. Play Billy's strand through to its last job.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Talk to the strangers marked on the map and follow each strand to its end — there are more than 8 strangers, so pick the strands you like.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade, PSN count 8). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's final mission. Follow Randy's strand to its last job.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's final mission. Follow Tyrone's strand to its last job.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Visit each meditation spot and complete the session there — check the map for spots you have not visited yet.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade, PSN count 18). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's lead to the animal he wants and take it down — the hunt is the point, so track it patiently.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Find cards across Leonida and finish any 3 full sets — trade duplicates where you can and keep a checklist of the cards you still need.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade, PSN count 3). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different spots — spread it across the map as you travel instead of grinding one area.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade, PSN count 100). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.guide: Finish 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's small goals and they stack up across every activity, so check the challenge list often and chase the ones closest to done.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade, PSN count 50). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — do this before the story ends. With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the heat and escape together. Pick a quiet area with good escape routes and keep your partner close until the stars clear.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade). Missable flag is our reading of the official description, not yet confirmed in-game. Guide advice is our own.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — do this before the story ends. With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level. Plan a route past three shops close together, keep the heat on through all three, and do not get caught between robberies.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade). Missable flag is our reading of the official description, not yet confirmed in-game. Guide advice is our own.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or enter new vehicles — each new model adds to the count, so try everything you see on the road instead of sticking to one car.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade, PSN count 100). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE in practice — the moment may not repeat. Down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a group of enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five before it ends.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade, PSN count 5). Missable flag is our reading of the official description, not yet confirmed in-game. Guide advice is our own.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE in practice — the moment may not repeat. Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the airport: find a way out that is not on the schedule, such as taking a plane off a runway yourself.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade). Missable flag is our reading of the official description, not yet confirmed in-game. Guide advice is our own.

trophies.guide: Rhinos are tanks, and this one is about tangling with them. Pick a fight with a Rhino and survive the heat it brings — heavy weapons and cover help.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE in practice — a blown attempt may lock the moment. Rob a jewelry store without being detected: go in quiet, avoid cameras and guards, grab the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade). Missable flag is our reading of the official description, not yet confirmed in-game. Guide advice is our own.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Plan each vault job, bring a getaway route, and get clear after every one — five clean escapes is what counts.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade, PSN count 5). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE in practice — the moment may not repeat. Rob an armored truck and escape: hit a truck on the road, grab the cash, and lose the heat before it catches up.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade). Missable flag is our reading of the official description, not yet confirmed in-game. Guide advice is our own.

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive through every named area until the map is filled in — the tracker counts areas, so sweep the map region by region.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade, PSN count 52). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. One hit per gang — learn which operation belongs to whom before you strike, and keep a list of the gangs you have hit.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade, PSN count 9). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE in practice — the moment may not repeat. Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach: find a bar on Ocean Beach with a view, order a drink, and enjoy it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade). Missable flag is our reading of the official description, not yet confirmed in-game. Guide advice is our own.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE in practice — the moment may not repeat. Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: drive a car through the showroom glass and out the other side.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade). Missable flag is our reading of the official description, not yet confirmed in-game. Guide advice is our own.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE in practice — the moment may not repeat. Play a frame at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley: find the alley, rent a lane, and follow through on your throw.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade). Missable flag is our reading of the official description, not yet confirmed in-game. Guide advice is our own.

trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal. This one is tied to the story's partnership — keep playing the story and it will come. The official description keeps the exact moment vague, and so do we.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. PSN tracks a count up to 500 for this one — it follows the choices you make across the game, so just keep playing and choosing.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade, PSN count 500). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail at something, then succeed on the second try — a retry trophy that comes naturally while you play.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Something strange is out there in Leonida — keep your eyes open while exploring and it will find you.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE in practice — the moment may not repeat. Knock someone over with a melee drive-by: drive past a target and strike with a melee weapon from the moving vehicle.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade). Missable flag is our reading of the official description, not yet confirmed in-game. Guide advice is our own.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Earn marked bills from jobs, then pass them through your laundering contacts until the total hits $250,000.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade, PSN count 250000). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, food and gear — spending anywhere counts, so it climbs naturally as you play.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade, PSN count 100000). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Save up and purchase every garage on the market — garages also store the vehicles you collect.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade, PSN count 8). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Add ten vehicles you own to the app — register each one as you collect it.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.sources: Exophase (name, description, grade) · PSNProfiles (grade, PSN count 10). Guide advice is our own reading of the official description.
